keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Aston Villa 1. Alysson (Aston Villa) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by John McGinn.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Aston Villa 2. Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Delay in match (Aston Villa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Manchester United 1, Aston Villa 2. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Manchester United 2, Aston Villa 2. Youri Tielemans (Manchester United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Noussair Mazraoui.
Substitution, Manchester United. Ayden Heaven replaces Harry Maguire.
Goal! Manchester United 2, Aston Villa 3. John McGinn (Aston Villa) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Manchester United 2, Aston Villa 4. Leon Goretzka (Aston Villa) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Nicolas Jackson following a set piece situation.
Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Alysson (Aston Villa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Youri Tielemans.
Substitution, Manchester United. Patrick Dorgu replaces Diogo Dalot.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Amad Diallo.
Substitution, Aston Villa. George Hemmings replaces John McGinn.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Ross Barkley replaces Alysson.
Delay in match because of an injury Johan Manzambi (Aston Villa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Aston Villa. João Gomes replaces Johan Manzambi.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Ibrahim Mbaye replaces Leon Goretzka.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Bryan Mbeumo.
